subject: ERROR application requested to terminate in an unusual way

messages.author: 734c3a9b4a09c966
messages.subject: ERROR application requested to terminate in an unusual way
parts:
Hi,
I'm running the following code and when I arrive to the "result" it gives me an error, crashing down R
Error:" this application has requested the runtime to terminate it in a unusual way...."

Code:

P <- data$ind_priv
P <- P-mean(P)  

quintis<-as.numeric(cut2(P,g=5))

P.q2<- quintis
P.q2[quintis ==2]<-1
P.q2[quintis!=2]<-0
P.q3<- quintis
P.q3[quintis ==3]<-1
P.q3[quintis!=3]<-0
P.q4<- quintis
P.q4[quintis ==4]<-1
P.q4[quintis!=4]<-0
P.q5<- quintis
P.q5[quintis ==5]<-1
P.q5[quintis!=5]<-0

Resp<-data.frame(region=1:dim(data)[1],region.struct=1:dim(data)[1],observados=data$observados,esperados=data$esperados,
                    P.q2=P.q2,P.q3= P.q3, P.q4= P.q4,P.q5= P.q5)


formula2 <- observados ~ f(region.struct,model="besag",graph="C:/area_de_estudo_matriz.inla",
                           hyper=list(theta=list(prior="logtgaussian",param=c(0,0.0001))))+f(region,model="iid",
                            hyper=list(theta=list(prior="logtgaussian",param=c(0,0.0001)))) +P.q2+P.q3+P.q4+P.q5


result <- inla(formula2,family="poisson",data= Resp,E= esperados,control.compute=list(dic=T,cpo=TRUE),control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,cdf=c(log(1))))+


I have used this code before without trouble. 
Do you know what can be?

Best wishes,
Ricardo
